# Gneiss for VS Code

> **Gneiss is pre-1.0 and subject to change.** Its colors may change before
> 1.0; the changelog lists every change.

Gneiss (pronounced "nice") is Nord's colors on neutral dark grays. It keeps
Nord's syntax and status colors and swaps its blue-gray backgrounds for
neutral grays with the same contrast steps between them.

To use it, run **Preferences: Color Theme** from the Command Palette and
choose **Gneiss**.

This theme is part of [Gneiss](https://gneisstheme.com),
which also has ports for Neovim, Alacritty, Vicinae, Wayle and Obsidian. It
began as a fork of
[Nord's VS Code theme](https://github.com/nordtheme/visual-studio-code);
NOTICE has its license.
